notes.title: MAFATE - Update v0.3.6
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147019/544c1889113571eb9209c5e1c466979e2cd84fed.png"]MAFATE - Update v0.3.6
 Hello everyone! 👋  We’ve just released a small but important update to the **Pre-alpha Demo**.  



This patch focuses on polishing visuals and fixing several gameplay issues reported by you.   Thank you for your feedback — it’s helping us make MAFATE better every day! ❤️  ---  


✨ Added
 Ambient Occlusion & Decals in Balanced Quality Settings    

 Natacha’s kids’ drawings on Petunia Inn’s walls    
🛠 Fixed
 Collision stuck on Petunia’s house  

 Baby ducks falling into the void  

 Collision issue on Marla’s Duck Bridge  

 P3K not delivering all letters  


 ---  
📬 Keep the feedback coming!


We’re still in **Pre-alpha**, so every bug report and suggestion counts.  
Join our Discord to share your feedback, report bugs, and be part of the adventure!



– The Blue Ramen Studios Team

notes.title: 📢 MAFATE - Pre-alpha Demo v0.3.4 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147019/13d8b59f8e670138511daae45b2243899f54f5bc.png"]




📢 MAFATE - Pre-alpha Demo v0.3.4 is LIVE!

Hello everyone! 👋  
We are beyond excited to announce that the very first Pre-alpha Demo of MAFATE is now available on Steam!  
This build is version 0.3.4 — it’s not perfect, but it’s our first big step toward bringing you into the heart of the Cirque.

We want to thank you all for your interest, support, and patience. ❤️  
Your feedback is extremely valuable, so please share your thoughts and help us improve the game by joining our Discord server!

[hr][/hr]

🐞 Known Issues (we’re working on them!)
- Teleport bug: Leaving Marla and teleporting back to Marla can sometimes trap Elios. Opening the menu can unstuck him.
- Collision bug: Certain collisions, such as roofs, may trap the player.

Temporary Fix: If you get stuck, you can use the "Unstuck" option.  
Go to Menu → Settings → Unstuck to free your character.

[hr][/hr]

📬 We want your feedback!
We are currently in Pre-alpha, which means the game is still in active development.  
Your bug reports, gameplay impressions, and suggestions will help us shape the future of MAFATE.  
Join our Discord community to chat with us directly, report issues, and share your best screenshots!

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for helping us bring the magic of MAFATE to life — one delivery at a time!  
– The Blue Ramen Studios Team
